title: Tenma Saki — Peeking Around The Partition〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, everyone!
It's time to start our Late Nite Wednesday Talk Show viewing party♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know. Everyone at school was talking about it too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, most of the girls in my class said they saw it. They were all over Minori after it aired.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
The same thing happened to Haruka.
I wish I could've joined in on the fun...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You could have if you didn't suggest that we have a viewing party...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But it's always better to watch these things together!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
So, get ready!
It's gonna be a fun show♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Let's see what's hot right now!
It's trend surfing time!!!>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe. I got to see them do this part in person!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, here! I'm out of frame, but just behind this shelf!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
<Now then!
Today, we're visiting a cafe called “carino/carina” located on Main Street in Shibuya!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Lately, their new Mount Everest strawberry parfait has been going totally viral on social media.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Did you see?!
The camera caught me for a split second as it panned!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Let's rewind! Yeah, see...!
Right here!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Oh, yeah...
The shelf and partitions are casting a shadow on you, but I guess that's you...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. I'm so happy!
They got me right off the bat!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, we get it. Can we keep watching now?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It was. Haruka said that they'd only be given about ten minutes, but it ended up being close to twenty.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They probably got a lot of good footage and didn't want any of it to go to waste, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Especially when Minori and the others started helping the cafe staff after that group of wrestlers came in.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, there was so much excitement going on that time just flew by.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm so happy for you, Saki.
I don't think your cafe could've asked for anything better.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Also... I'm sorry that you didn't get to appear much...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: For some reason, Otori ended up getting more airtime, and she didn't show up until much later.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. She appeared for a few seconds here and there after Minori and the others began helping out...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
I was so excited about getting a chance to appear on TV...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, why do you want to be on TV so badly...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, why wouldn't you be happy to be on TV? I'd probably tell everyone I know about it!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, I get how you feel...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I didn't realize you wanted to be on TV that much.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sob*
No, it's okay. It's not like anybody would've recognized me...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Oh, you poor thing.
There there...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: As unfortunate as it is that you didn't appear, everybody there must know how hard you were working to keep the cafe running smoothly.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, cheer up.
I'm sure your boss couldn't be happier with how you handled things.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Pat me more!
And shower me with more praise!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You did a wonderful job.
I'm very proud of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
But I think she's right.
You did everything you could for that cafe.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
You're such an amazing girl, Saki.
Nobody works as hard as you do.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehe. Aren't I♪
*Sigh*
This is the best...
